reels.title: They Weren't Selling English, but a Better Job
reels.hook: They Weren't Selling English. They Were Selling a Better Job.
reels.why: A clear and applicable marketing insight: a product is sold through the outcome the customer wants, not through the service itself. It ends with a concise point from the host.

reels.quote: We didn't sell English to them. We sold them an opportunity to get a better job.

reels.hook: Why Does an AI Tutor Have a Face? Because of Fear.
reels.why: A surprising answer (avatars are not marketing, but a cure for fear) that can immediately be connected to one's own experience. The thought is rounded off: practice with a simulated interlocutor makes conversation with real people easier.

reels.quote: It just needs this feeling that, all right, somebody's watching at me right now.
